news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS in line with analyst expectations despite revenue beat
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹15.10 (up from ₹12.89 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹29.7b (up 18% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹4.11b (up 17% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 14% (in line with FY 2025). Revenue exceeded analyst estimates by 1.2%. Earnings per share (EPS) were mostly in line with analyst estimates. Revenue is forecast to grow 13% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 17% growth forecast for the Specialty Retail industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 3% per year whereas the company’s share price has increased by 4% per year.

news.title: METROBRAND: Steady Assumptions And Upcoming Dividend Decision Will Support Future Returns
news.body: Analysts have kept their fair value estimate for Metro Brands broadly steady at about ₹1,198 per share, while fine tuning assumptions such as a slightly lower discount rate of 14.30% and a marginally adjusted future P/E of about 72.65x. This reflects updated views on the stock's risk profile and earnings power without a material change to the long term price target.

news.title: METROBRAND: Measured Store Expansion And New Formats Will Support Future Returns
news.body: Analysts have slightly reduced their price target for Metro Brands to around ₹1,198 from about ₹1,211, reflecting updated assumptions on discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin, and forward P/E that leave the core outlook broadly unchanged. What's in the News During Third Quarter FY26, Metro Brands opened 35 new stores and closed 11, with 100 openings and 18 closures over the nine month period, indicating a measured approach to expanding its retail footprint (Key Developments).

news.title: METROBRAND: New Sports Format Expansion Will Support Future Returns
news.body: Analysts have trimmed their price target on Metro Brands to ₹1,211 from ₹1,272, citing slightly more conservative assumptions for revenue growth, profit margins, the discount rate and future P/E multiples. What's in the News During Third Quarter FY26, Metro Brands opened 35 new stores and closed 11, with 100 openings and 18 closures over the nine-month period, indicating a calibrated approach to expanding its retail network (company disclosure).

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings: EPS and revenues exceed analyst expectations
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹4.71 (up from ₹3.48 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹8.27b (up 18% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹1.28b (up 36% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 16% (up from 14% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue exceeded analyst estimates by 3.2%. Earnings per share (EPS) also surpassed analyst estimates by 2.5%. Revenue is forecast to grow 15% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 18% growth forecast for the Specialty Retail industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 2% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 10% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: METROBRAND: New Athletic Format Expansion Will Drive Future Returns
news.body: Analysts have trimmed their fair value estimate for Metro Brands from ₹1,286.95 to ₹1,272.10 as small tweaks to the discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin assumptions and future P/E expectations flow through their models. What's in the News Board meeting scheduled on January 27, 2026 to consider and approve the unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and nine months ended December 31, 2025, along with the statutory auditors' limited review report (Key Developments).

news.title: METROBRAND: New Sports Concept And Dividends Will Drive Future Upside
news.body: Analysts have modestly trimmed their price target on Metro Brands to ₹1,285 from ₹1,289, reflecting a slightly higher perceived risk via a raised discount rate, even as long term revenue growth and profitability assumptions remain broadly intact. What's in the News Metro Brands launched MetroActiv, a new multi brand athletic footwear and sportswear retail concept, expanding its presence in the sports performance segment with leading global brands and an omni channel model including metroactiv.com (company announcement).
